title: UC introduces AI Buddy Program for staff amid learning, privacy concerns
snippet: The University of California Office of the President launched the AI Buddy Program, pairing staff of differing AI expertise to meet weekly. However, UCLA faculty raised concerns regarding data security, privacy, and the potential for AI to replace human workers.

title: AI detection tools miss the mark for student assessment
snippet: A study by a James Cook University researcher has found that using artificial intelligence detection software in student assessment is fundamentally unreliable and risks undermining, rather than protecting, academic integrity.
match_reason: websearch (press_release) — This study provides critical evidence on the unreliability of AI detection tools, directly informing the committee's mandate on academic integrity and assessment design.

title: Cornell expands AI Critical Literacy Program for incoming students
snippet: Cornell University is expanding its AI Critical Literacy Program to all incoming students, faculty, and staff this fall. Delivered via Canvas, the program features modules on generative AI, ethics, learning, and personal AI policies to foster critical dialogue and responsible use.
match_reason: websearch (news_article) — This represents a major peer R1 university's system-wide initiative to mandate or widely offer AI literacy training to incoming students, serving as a key precedent for UC-level student access and policy decisions.

title: UCR researchers join DOE effort to speed scientific discovery
snippet: Two UC Riverside computer scientists have joined federally funded projects under the Department of Energy's Genesis Mission. The projects will leverage artificial intelligence to accelerate scientific discovery, focusing on quantum computing error correction and smarter scientific data sharing.
match_reason: websearch (news_article) — This highlights a University of California campus's direct involvement in major federally funded AI research initiatives, aligning with the committee's mandate on AI in research.
